section_summary.extract_value: This section details the analytical procedures used, including coefficient alpha reliability analyses for CAT tasks, computation of correlation coefficients among intelligence and creativity tasks (with an alpha level of .01), and four hierarchical linear regression analyses. The regression analyses were conducted in two ways: using creativity measures (CAQ subtests and SAC questionnaire) to predict overall Glr and Gc, and using intelligence measures (overall Glr and Gc) to predict rated creativity in Drawing and Poetry. The text describes a single set of analyses for an unspecified study.
